findings.title: ShinyHunters: Cyber Criminal Group Attacks Learning Management System
findings.summary_md: FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center alert I-051526-PSA warning that ShinyHunters specializes in large-scale data breaches and extortion and pressures victims through harassment, threatening texts and calls to family members, swatting, and false claims of possessing compromising material. The PSA followed a ShinyHunters attack on an online Learning Management System that disrupted educational institutions and students across the country, and recommends against paying or responding to extortion demands.

findings.title: Oracle Security Alert Advisory - CVE-2026-35273
findings.summary_md: Out-of-band Oracle Security Alert for CVE-2026-35273, a remotely exploitable without authentication remote code execution vulnerability (CVSS 3.1 base score 9.8) in the Updates Environment Management component of PeopleSoft Enterprise PeopleTools versions 8.61 and 8.62. The advisory provides mitigation guidance and credits Bobby Gould, Lucas Miller, and Minh Giang of TrendAI Zero Day Initiative and TrendAI Research. Modification history shows initial release on June 10, 2026.

findings.title: ShinyHunters Targets Education Sector with Oracle PeopleSoft Exploit
findings.summary_md: Mandiant and Google Threat Intelligence Group attribute a PeopleSoft compromise and extortion campaign to UNC6240 (ShinyHunters), observed May 27 through June 9, 2026 and consistent with zero-day exploitation of CVE-2026-35273 before Oracle's June 10 advisory. The actor staged MeshCentral agents masquerading as Azure services with C2 at wss://azurenetfiles.net:443/agent.ashx, propagated a fanout.sh lateral movement script over SSH, and published stolen data on the ShinyHunters leak site on June 9. Mandiant notified over 100 organizations whose IP addresses correlated with potentially vulnerable endpoints, 68 percent of them higher education institutions.
